title: Thialf 海上起重船
summary: 以Thialf工程船公開背景，學習兩個載荷介面如何對船舶產生不同力矩；比較平衡條件、量測同步與負載移交資料。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Thialf’s public context to study different moments from two load interfaces, comparing equilibrium, synchronized measurements and handover records. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 將兩個載荷分別列入質量帳：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: List the two payloads separately: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 將兩個載荷分別列入質量帳 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of List the two payloads separately and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將兩個載荷分別列入質量帳：靜浮平衡時船舶總質量等於排開水的質量；載重、設備、燃料和船體質量應分欄。 本步以「船舶排水質量帳」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: List the two payloads separately: At static flotation, vessel mass equals displaced-water mass; payload, equipment, fuel and hull belong in separate ledger columns. Use Vessel displacement mass ledger to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Thialf 海上起重船實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積V=500 m³。式 m=ρV，基準結果 512.5 t。條件：僅靜水質量平衡；不等於總噸位，也未判定完整穩度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Thialf offshore crane vessel: ρ=1025 kg/m³, displacement volume V=500 m³. Formula m=ρV gives 512.5 t. Conditions: Static mass balance only; this is not gross tonnage and does not establish intact stability.
steps.failure: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 以四欄裝載表加總後與排水質量比對，標出尚未計入的人員、淡水與備品。 本案例另須檢查「將兩個載荷分別列入質量帳」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Sum a four-column loading table and compare with displacement mass; flag omitted people, freshwater and spares. Also check that List the two payloads separately and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：將兩個載荷分別列入質量帳。在雙載荷紙面圖、重心標記和同步力訊號完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為512.5，改變後為563.75 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: List the two payloads separately. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Two-load paper diagram, center markers and synchronized force signals. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 512.5 changes to 563.75 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Thialf 海上起重船」的「將兩個載荷分別列入質量帳：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海上能源：岸電交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “List the two payloads separately: Mechanism and observation” in “Thialf offshore crane vessel”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 用統一原點計算重心位置：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Use a common origin for center position: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 用統一原點計算重心位置 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Use a common origin for center position and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用統一原點計算重心位置：縱向重心是各部分質量與位置的加權平均；配重移動改變重心而不改變總質量。 本步以「配重與重心位置」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Use a common origin for center position: Longitudinal center of mass is a mass-weighted position; moving ballast changes the center without changing total mass. Use Ballast and center-of-mass position to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Thialf 海上起重船實際規格：基體40 kg在x=0、配重m=5 kg在x=0.5 m。式 xG=Σmixi/Σmi，基準結果 0.055555556 m。條件：剛性桌面模型；重心不是浮心，沒有直接推算真實姿態。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Conditions: Rigid desktop model; center of mass is not center of buoyancy and does not directly predict real attitude.
steps.failure: 將配重位置相對不同原點輸入會造成假重心漂移；先統一座標與正方向。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Entering ballast positions relative to different origins produces false center shifts; align coordinates and sign conventions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

steps.checkEn: Mark body and ballast on a cardboard coordinate map, move the same ballast and recalculate; compare support reactions to check direction. Also check that Use a common origin for center position and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

steps.objective: 區分 用統一原點計算重心位置 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Use a common origin for center position with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 將配重位置相對不同原點輸入會造成假重心漂移；先統一座標與正方向。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.instructionEn: Entering ballast positions relative to different origins produces false center shifts; align coordinates and sign conventions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Thialf 海上起重船實際規格：基體40 kg在x=0、配重m=5 kg在x=0.5 m。式 xG=Σmixi/Σmi，基準結果 0.055555556 m。條件：剛性桌面模型；重心不是浮心，沒有直接推算真實姿態。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Thialf offshore crane vessel: Body 40 kg at x=0, ballast m=5 kg at x=0.5 m. Formula xG=Σmixi/Σmi gives 0.055555556 m. Conditions: Rigid desktop model; center of mass is not center of buoyancy and does not directly predict real attitude.
steps.failure: 將配重位置相對不同原點輸入會造成假重心漂移；先統一座標與正方向。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Entering ballast positions relative to different origins produces false center shifts; align coordinates and sign conventions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 在紙板座標圖標示基體和配重，平移同一配重後重算；對照支點反力確認方向。 本案例另須檢查「用統一原點計算重心位置」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Mark body and ballast on a cardboard coordinate map, move the same ballast and recalculate; compare support reactions to check direction. Also check that Use a common origin for center position and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：用統一原點計算重心位置。在雙載荷紙面圖、重心標記和同步力訊號完成資料或紙面模型練習。只將配重質量增加10%，保持位置固定，比較重心而非把它當傾角。 算式區的基準值為0.055555556，改變後為0.06043956 m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Use a common origin for center position. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Two-load paper diagram, center markers and synchronized force signals. Increase ballast mass alone by 10%, fix its position and compare center of mass rather than interpreting it as an angle. Baseline 0.055555556 changes to 0.06043956 m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
將配重向前移動會同時增加總排水重量。
將配重位置相對不同原點輸入會造成假重心漂移；先統一座標與正方向。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Moving ballast forward necessarily increases displacement weight.
Entering ballast positions relative to different origins produces false center shifts; align coordinates and sign conventions first.
quiz.explanation: 將配重位置相對不同原點輸入會造成假重心漂移；先統一座標與正方向。 在紙板座標圖標示基體和配重，平移同一配重後重算；對照支點反力確認方向。 本案例另須檢查「用統一原點計算重心位置」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Entering ballast positions relative to different origins produces false center shifts; align coordinates and sign conventions first. Mark body and ballast on a cardboard coordinate map, move the same ballast and recalculate; compare support reactions to check direction. Also check that Use a common origin for center position and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.
